title: Stitchboard: field signal + runtime asks (mini-sprint capture)
content:
Purpose:
Capture multi-customer runtime and UX asks gathered during the Feb 18–Feb 28 field sprint. This is an operational stitchboard: mix of raw quotes, pattern synthesis, proposed quick patches, and suggested owners/estimates for an engineering mini-sprint (2 weeks). Aim: identify 3–5 high-leverage fixes we can ship quickly and a set of medium-term improvements for Q2 planning.

High-level themes (frequency across calls):
1) Transparent model fallback and observable impact (10 mentions) — customers want to see when a cheaper variant or fallback is used and token/latency delta.
2) Per-route caching controls and cache invalidation hooks (8 mentions) — teams with dynamic prompts want programmatic control for prefix caches.
3) Billing attribution for split routes / rerouting (7 mentions) — when requests are routed to different dedicated pools or fallback variants, customers want clear billing line items.
4) Embedding drift alerts + sample audits (5 mentions) — embed quality regressions after model updates flagged but no easy repro.
5) Streaming resume after transient disconnects (4 mentions) — UX pain when streaming disconnects, clients must re-request from scratch.

Representative customer quotes:
- "We had a canary cut over and our latency halved but costs spiked — no clear way to show the tradeoffs to finance." — fintech POC
- "Prefix cache is amazing when it works; but when a prompt param changes, we have to wait TTL and reprune manually." — edtech product manager
- "Embedding drift alert fired but the samples were not representative — we need quick sample audits and a rollback knob." — search team

Concrete requests (ranked for mini-sprint):
A. Fallback visibility header + telemetry flag (High priority, quick)
   - What: Add a response header and control-plane flag that marks when fallback model/variant was used and the reason (capacity|latency|policy). Expose token delta estimate and latency difference.
   - Why: Removes ambiguity for CS/finance calls; reduces investigations.
   - Customer impact: All hosted API customers using rollout/fallback.
   - Owner: eng-console-and-rollouts (suggested: Jonas K.)
   - Estimate: 3 engineering days + 1 day infra ops
   - Next step: Prototype telemetry header in /v1/response and doc update in Console docs.

B. Per-route cache control API (Medium-high, patch)
   - What: Add api param cache_control: {invalidate_key, ttl_override, lock:false} as optional in inference request. Provide a console toggle for route-level default.
   - Why: Empowers customers with dynamic workflows (e.g., templated prompts with per-session overrides).
   - Customer impact: personalization-heavy customers (adtech, edtech).
   - Owner: serving-runtime + product-hosted-api (suggested: Priya D.)
   - Estimate: 6 engineering days + UX small change
   - Risk: Security review for API surface.

C. Route-level billing breakdown (Medium, policy + infra)
   - What: When smart-routing splits a request into variants (primary/fallback/dedicated), emit billing records per subcall and surface in Console cost table.
   - Why: Removes finance ambiguity, reduces support churn.
   - Owner: billing + console-and-rollouts (suggested: Lena O.)
   - Estimate: 8 engineering days + data pipeline work

D. Streaming resume token checkpointing (Low-medium, UX win)
   - What: Allow client to include last_ack_token to resume a streaming response from a recent token boundary; store lightweight checkpoints for 30s.
   - Why: Improve reliability for flaky mobile networks and websockets.
   - Owner: devex + serving-runtime
   - Estimate: 5 engineering days

Medium-term initiatives (Q2 candidates):
- Embedding drift sampling tool: periodically surface representative failed examples + automated rollback to previous embedding model (requires eval infra and metrics hooks).
- Model-change preflight sandbox: run a sampled traffic subset against variant and publish delta reports (latency, cost, output-quality) to Console before rollout.
- Enhanced route ACLs for private deployments: more granular KMS/tenant isolation signals in billing and logs.

Open questions / unresolved items:
- How granular should the fallback reasons be? (capacity|region|policy|quantization mismatch) — Ops input needed.
- Data retention for resume checkpoints (regulatory concerns). Legal review flagged.
- Billing attribution for cross-customer shared GPUs (accounting nuance). Finance to weigh in.

Proposed mini-sprint backlog (first-pass order):
1) Fallback visibility header + docs (A)
2) Cache control API minimal patch (invalidate key + ttl) (B)
3) Streaming resume POC (D)
4) Route billing breakdown scoping doc (C - scope only)

Meeting asks / owners:
- Jonas Kim: prototype header + talk with runtime team by 2025-03-09
- Priya Desai: draft cache-control API RFC and security checklist by 2025-03-10
- Lena Ortiz: draft billing scoping doc and sample cost UI mockups by 2025-03-12
- Maya Patel (CS): schedule customer follow-ups to validate acceptance criteria for A & B (reach out to 6 customers listed below)

Customers to validate acceptance criteria (contacted in Feb):
- NovaPay (fintech), contact: david@novapay.com
- Learnly Inc (edtech), contact: rachel@learnly.com
- ScoutSearch (search infra), contact: tom@scoutsearch.ai
- RetailVerse (commerce), contact: anika@retailverse.com
- Beacon Health (healthcare), contact: emma@beaconhealth.org
- MicroAgent Labs (startups), contact: lee@microagent.io

Appendix: raw snippets from field calls (unedited)
- "If I can't show the canary's cost, CFO shuts the project down — we need a per-request cost trace."
- "Cache TTLs are unpredictable when we have experiment-driven prompts — a manual invalidate API would be perfect."
- "Streaming disconnects on our mobile SDKs are our #1 NPS driver for latency complaints."

Immediate next steps:
- Triage meeting 2025-03-06 10:00 PST (invite: eng-console, serving-runtime, billing, devex, cs).
- Convert A/B backlog items into JIRA ticket stubs and attach sample customer repros.
- Add a small monitoring dashboard: count of fallback events by route for the past 7 days.

Notes to self: keep this doc iterative — add customer acceptance notes after validation calls and replace estimates with JIRA-linked epics once scoped.
